title: Helix — workflow automation where agents work and people approve
description: A light, spring-animated landing page for an AI workflow automation platform. The hero is a live approval queue: agents stop on risky steps (a large refund, a changed payee, production access) and the visitor approves or sends back each request with the evidence attached, while a feed shows the work the agents finished on their own. A pinned four-step story, a team switcher, readable guardrail policies with a kill switch, and per-approver pricing follow.
features: Approval queue you work through: approve or send back with buttons or the A and R keys, stamp animation, the next request expands with a layout spring
New requests keep arriving and a feed shows what agents finished without asking
Agent plan checklist that ticks itself off
Route-to menu for escalations and a sign-and-seal approval record
Team switcher with a stretching pill and per-team workflow pipelines
Plain-English policies with switches that explain what changes when turned off
Hold-to-pause kill switch for every agent
Per-approver pricing with a rubber-band stepper and rolling total
